name: repressilator-steady-state
title: Repressilator steady state (COPASI/basico)
question: Driven as a process-bigraph Step, does COPASI solve the steady state of the bundled Elowitz (2000) repressilator and return a structure-consistent fixed point?
hypothesis: The CopasiSteadyStateStep, loading the bundled repressilator SBML (BIOMD0000000012), converges to a symmetric fixed point where each protein sits at exactly 100x its mRNA (the model's translation/degradation ratio) and the three genes are identical by symmetry.
objective: Demonstrate end to end that viva_copasi.composites.steady-state runs the real COPASI solver on a published model and emits correct species concentrations and reaction fluxes, with COPASI acting as a pluggable process-bigraph engine.
description: The basic-functionality showcase for viva-copasi. build_composite("steady-state") wires CopasiSteadyStateStep to the bundled repressilator and asks COPASI's steady-state solver for the circuit's balance point. COPASI returns mRNA X=Y=Z=2.40822 and protein PX=PY=PZ=240.822, with a translation flux of 16.6925 and a transcription flux of 0.83463. The companion utc-process composite integrates the same model forward as an oscillator (a dynamics variant).

expected_behavior.name: protein-mrna-stoichiometry
expected_behavior.en: At steady state each protein sits at exactly 100x its mRNA — the model's translation-over-degradation ratio.
expected_behavior.rationale: For each gene, dP/dt=0 gives P = (k_translation / k_protein_deg) * mRNA; the bundled model's constants make that ratio exactly 100, so a correct solve must reproduce it.

expected_behavior.name: three-fold-symmetry
expected_behavior.en: The three genes are identical at the fixed point — mRNA (and protein) levels agree across X, Y, Z.
expected_behavior.rationale: The repressilator is cyclically symmetric (X-|Y-|Z-|X with identical parameters), so its symmetric fixed point must have X=Y=Z and PX=PY=PZ.

behavior_tests.name: protein-mrna-stoichiometry
behavior_tests.description: Max |protein/mRNA - 100| across the three genes < 1e-6 at the solved fixed point (observed ratio = 100.0 exactly; PX/X = 240.822/2.40822 = 100.0).

behavior_tests.name: three-fold-symmetry
behavior_tests.description: Max absolute spread among {X,Y,Z} and among {PX,PY,PZ} < 1e-6 (observed X=Y=Z=2.40822, PX=PY=PZ=240.822 to machine precision).

findings.name: steady-state-fixed-point
findings.statement: COPASI solves the bundled repressilator to X=Y=Z=2.40822 (mRNA) and PX=PY=PZ=240.822 (protein), with translation flux 16.6925 and transcription flux 0.83463 — a symmetric fixed point with a protein/mRNA ratio of 100.0.
findings.provenance: Observed in an isolated-venv run of viva_copasi.composites.steady-state on viva-copasi 0.2.2 / basico 0.93, 2026-11-27 (reproduced by sims/run.py).

conclusion: PASS on both acceptance bands. Run as a process-bigraph Step, COPASI solved the bundled Elowitz repressilator to a clean symmetric fixed point: protein/mRNA ratio = 100.0 (< 1e-6 error) and three-fold gene symmetry to machine precision. COPASI behaves as a drop-in process-bigraph engine, emitting real species concentrations and reaction fluxes.

derived.insight: COPASI solves the bundled repressilator to X=Y=Z=2.40822 (mRNA) and PX=PY=PZ=240.822 (protein), with translation flux 16.6925 and transcription flux 0.83463 — a symmetric fixed point with a protein/mRNA ratio of 100.0.
